items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Because I left Andy shortly after that, and went with Georgie Auld's band.

ctx.x: Yeah, '43. Maybe the first part of '44, I don't know. But I think it was the last part of '43. Because I left Andy shortly after that, and went with Georgie Auld's band.
Now, that was kind of an all-star band, no?
